project_context: Redesign 3 React templates (clean, bold, warm) for ContractorSite.js, making them image-forward, premium, and highly visual while retaining existing section structures.

global_instructions.styling: Tailwind CSS + inline styles for dynamic accent_color.
global_instructions.component_architecture: Keep existing React component structure and data bindings. Enhance visually with Tailwind, dynamic classes, and proper section treatments.
global_instructions.theme_handling: Accent color is dynamic (user-selected). Ensure text contrast over accent colors (use white or black conditionally, or stick to safe accent usages like borders/text/buttons).

image_strategy.logic: Always prefer user-uploaded photos (data.hero_photo, data.photos). If missing or empty, use trade-specific high-quality stock fallbacks.
image_strategy.treatment: Hero images MUST have an overlay to ensure text legibility. Service cards should have a fixed aspect ratio (e.g., aspect-video) with object-cover. Images must drive the visual flavor of the site.

clean.name: Clean & Modern
clean.theme: Light mode primary, with white/gray surfaces.

colors.accent_usage: Primary buttons, hover states, icons, subtle section borders

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, sticky top-0, z-50, 1px border-b border-gray-200/50
surfaces.cards: rounded-2xl, border border-gray-100, shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow bg-white

section_treatments.hero: Full-bleed image. Gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-900/90 via-gray-900/60 to-transparent). White text. Left-aligned content. Accent color CTA.
section_treatments.services: Alternating bands (Image Left / Text Right) or simple grid with large 16:9 images and content below.
section_treatments.how_it_works: Simple vertical timeline or clean horizontal steps with subtle accent lines.
section_treatments.why_us: Bento Grid: asymmetrical layout with icons inside cards.
section_treatments.gallery: Clean 3-column masonry or uniform grid with hover-zoom.

bold.name: Bold & Industrial
bold.theme: Dark mode primary (or ultra high-contrast light), representing heavy-duty work.

colors.accent_usage: Solid background for buttons, thick borders, large numbers in 'How it works'.

surfaces.header: Solid bg-zinc-950 with a sharp bottom border using the accent color.
surfaces.cards: Brutalist: rounded-none, border-2 border-zinc-800, hover styles applying the accent color, solid shadows

section_treatments.hero: Full-bleed with heavy bg-black/60 overlay. Centered, massive typography (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Badge at the top.
section_treatments.services: Dense, tall cards with dark gradient overlays on the images.
section_treatments.reviews: High contrast blocks, large quote marks.

colors.accent_usage: Soft overlays, badge backgrounds, icons, primary buttons.

surfaces.header: Floating pill-shaped nav (rounded-full) just below top margin, shadow-sm bg-white/90 backdrop-blur.
surfaces.cards: rounded-3xl, soft ambient shadow (shadow-xl shadow-stone-200/50), border border-stone-100

section_treatments.hero: Not full bleed. Large rounded container (rounded-[2rem] or [3rem]) with the image. Warm tint overlay.
section_treatments.services: Cards where the image has a soft corner radius and overlaps the text section.
section_treatments.how_it_works: Staggered layout with circular image steps.
section_treatments.why_us: Cards with soft colored backgrounds (using accent color at 10-15% opacity).
section_treatments.gallery: Grid with rounded-2xl edges, slightly overlapping or staggered.

trust_urgency_elements.badges: Include 'Licensed & Insured' and 'X Years Experience' pills near the H1 in the hero.
trust_urgency_elements.phone_forward: Header and sticky mobile bar must prominently feature the phone number.
trust_urgency_elements.ctas: Use high-conversion copy: 'Get a Fast Quote', 'Book Now', 'Text Us'.
trust_urgency_elements.social_proof: Highlight 5-star ratings with visual stars (lucide-react stars) near the CTAs and in the reviews section.

motion.hover_states: All buttons should have subtle scale (hover:-translate-y-0.5) and shadow transitions. Service cards should slightly lift on hover.
motion.scroll: Use simple entrance animations for sections using CSS transitions where possible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over hero images and accent colors meets 4.5:1 ratio. Use text-shadow on text if the image overlay is too light.
accessibility.interactive: Include focus-visible rings on all links and buttons.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this by strictly following the typography, spacing, and surface rules for each specific template.
For the dynamic accent color, use React inline styles for dynamic classes (e.g., style={{ backgroundColor: accentColor }}) because Tailwind cannot compile dynamic arbitrary values.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. Overlays must have proper background/opacity.
Images MUST NOT be empty. Implement fallback logic: if data.hero_photo or data.photos is undefined/empty, use the specific stock fallbacks provided.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Keep the structure of the ContractorSite.js component intact; do not remove any existing sections, functionalities, or data props. Only elevate them visually.
Ensure layouts are mobile-first, heavily utilizing flex and grid. Mobile conversions matter most.
Use generous padding (py-16, py-24) to let sections breathe, instead of cramping them together.
